task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First stop, make an attempt to travel east. After that, go to the north. With that over with, go north. With that done, open the hatch. After that, take a trip north. If you can do that, make an effort to head east. Then, attempt to go north. Then, make an effort to go west. And then, lift the cookie from the floor of the silent workshop. Got that? Good!
